output.summary: Mixed results: paid use 3 of 4 (not met), deployment effort above the assumption (not met), buyer fit mixed (inconclusive). Recommendation: revise and extend, not scale.

whatWeLearned: Three of four pilot customers met the paid-use and continuation threshold; one did not.
Deployment effort per site was above the assumption. Installation needs more operations time than planned.
The specialist sign-off covered the pilot only. Scale readiness has not been reviewed.
causalLimitations: Results describe these sites, not the reachable pool.
No revenue is attributed to the pilot beyond its own billing.
proposals.rationale: Not scale. Test deployment effort and the fourth site under a scoped extension before any G3 request.

claim.statement: G3 preconditions are not met: the demand threshold and the scale-readiness review are open.

unknowns: Whether the fourth site's decline was price or timing
